autosleep.message.bed_unusable: AutoSleep could not use the bed at %s, %s, %s and leaves it alone until the next night.
autosleep.message.bed_unreachable: AutoSleep found no way to the bed at %s, %s, %s and leaves it alone until the next night.
autosleep.message.bed_not_safe: Monsters stayed near the bed at %s, %s, %s for 30 seconds: AutoSleep stops trying it until the next night.
autosleep.message.stopped: A Baritone command took over from AutoSleep: it leaves you awake until the next night.
autosleep.message.disabled: AutoSleep is off: another Baritone jar in your mods folder, such as baritone-standalone-fabric, replaced the Baritone API that AutoSleep bundles. Remove that jar to use AutoSleep.
